meta.title: {product} — hiring on equal terms for designers and companies
meta.description: Designers get ghosted. Companies get no-shows and resumes that say nothing. {product} puts both sides on equal terms: the same standards for everyone, a clear process for every role, and a track record each side can see.

hero.eyebrow: For designers and companies in Israel
hero.headline:
Hiring is broken.

On both sides.
hero.subheadline: Designers get ghosted. Companies get no-shows and resumes that say nothing. {product} puts both sides on equal terms: the same standards for everyone, a clear process for every role, and a track record each side can see.

twoSides.title: How we fix it
twoSides.companiesNote: Companies join after the designer community is in place.

answers.fix: Every company commits to answering every application on time. If it's a no, they tell you why.

work.pain: Filtered out by keywords and HR screens.
work.fix: Companies see your case studies, not a keyword-matched resume.

process.pain: Processes that drag on with no end date.
process.fix: Every role shows its interview stages and expected timeline before you apply.

trackRecord.pain: No way to tell good employers from bad ones.
trackRecord.fix: Every company has a track record: how often they answer, how fast, and whether their process matches what they promised.

work.pain: Resumes that say nothing about craft.
work.fix: Every visible profile shows real work: at least one case study with process and outcome.

reliability.pain: Candidates who skip interviews or never reply.
reliability.fix: Every designer has a reliability record too: response rate and interview attendance.

fees.fix: You pay for access, never per hire. You search and reach out to designers yourself.

confidential.pain: Hiring in a market where everyone knows everyone.
confidential.fix: Designers can search confidentially, so you can reach people who aren't openly looking.

steps.caseStudy: Fill in your profile and add at least one case study, and you're ready to be found
steps.found: When companies join, they search and reach out. You decide who to talk to.

notAgency.title: Not a hiring agency
notAgency.lead: We don't place, introduce or recommend candidates.
notAgency.body: Designers and companies find each other directly. Companies search and reach out on their own, and designers decide who to talk to. We set the rules both sides agree to, and make sure they're kept.

audience.title: Who it's for
audience.body: Product, UX/UI and web designers at any stage of their career, with real projects to show.

founding.title: Founding members
founding.body: We're starting small: first we're building the designer community, and companies join next. The first designers will help shape how this works.

form.title: Create your profile
form.intro: Just an email and a password. You'll add your work and details after you sign in.

fields.confidential: My search is confidential (I'm currently employed)
fields.consent: I've read the <link>privacy policy</link> and agree to my details being stored to use the platform

form.goodToKnow: Joining doesn't guarantee a job. Companies on the platform search and reach out to designers themselves. What we do guarantee: the same rules for both sides, and consequences for anyone who breaks them.
form.notConnected: The form isn't connected yet. Sign-up will work in the next build stage.

errors.invalidUrl: Enter a full link, for example https://yourportfolio.com
errors.invalidLinkedin: Enter a LinkedIn profile link, for example https://www.linkedin.com/in/yourname
errors.tooFast: That was quick. Please take a moment and try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please try again in an hour.

privacyNotice.title: Your privacy
privacyNotice.body: At signup we ask only for your email. Everything else you add to your profile yourself. Our team sees it for moderation only, and you can delete your account at any time.

checkEmail.title: Check your email.
checkEmail.body: We've sent you a link to confirm your address. Then sign in and start your profile. It may take a minute; check spam if you don't see it.

login.title: Log in
login.removed: This account has been removed. If you think this is a mistake, contact us at {email}.
login.notConnected: Login isn't connected yet. It will work in a later build stage.

forgotPassword.title: Reset your password
forgotPassword.intro: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to set a new password.
forgotPassword.sent: If there's an account for this email, we've sent a reset link.
forgotPassword.notConnected: Password reset isn't connected yet. It will work in a later build stage.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: Short and plain: what we store, why, and what you control.

what.title: What we store
what.body: Your email, and the details and work you add to your profile, including a link to your portfolio (and LinkedIn, if you add it).

why.title: Why
why.body: To show your profile to companies on the platform, and to keep the platform safe (for example, removing fake profiles).

who.title: Who sees it
who.body: Our team, for moderation only. Once companies join, registered companies see your profile according to the privacy settings you choose. Phone and email are shown only if you choose to. Your reliability record (response and attendance) is visible to registered companies.

control.title: Your control
control.body: You can view, correct or delete your data at any time, from your profile or by email.

unconfirmed.title: Unconfirmed sign-ups
unconfirmed.body: If you sign up but never confirm your email, we delete your details after 14 days.

footer.notAgency: Not a recruitment or placement agency. Designers and companies find each other directly.

moderationReason.fake_profile: Profile appears fake or not a real designer
moderationReason.work_not_own: Work shown isn't the designer's own or isn't credited
